topics.title: Please select 'YES' to agree and confirm your participation.

questionnaireData.description: Users who register between 1-31Jan 2026, will qualify for the rewards.

textContent.value: Daily Ranking is open to all MY/BN/SG users, with no selected users required to join, and will start and end at 00:00–23:59 each day. The top 15 users who meet the event requirement and threshold daily will earn bean rewards.

For the Weekly Ranking, there will be 4 weekly rankings from January 6 to January 31, 2026. Users can claim rewards each week if they reach the minimum points requirement and rank in the Top 50 for that week.
📢 Data will be updated weekly every Monday at 3 PM, except on weekends.
Event is offered to December 2025 SVIP users. Users who upgrade their SVIP level within 31 days in January 2026 can claim rewards. Rewards are limited to the first 100 participants.
